# Estate

The root estate record — will, intestacy, or trust-based succession plan. Contains testator details, jurisdiction, will formalities, forced heirship, probate grants, death record, multi-jurisdiction administration, and tax treaty positions

Source: [`v3/estate.json`](../../v3/estate.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/estate.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this estate record |
| `testatorPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Person.id of the testator (the person whose estate this is) |
| `testatorPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced testator person |
| `status` | one of `planning`, `confirmed`, `pre_probate`, `in_administration`, `distributed`, `closed` | yes | The lifecycle status of this estate record. Progresses from planning through to closure |
| `domicile` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | yes | The testator's domicile — the jurisdiction whose succession law governs moveable property by default. For cross-border estates, individual assets may declare their own applicableLaw |
| `willType` | one of `secular`, `religious`, `dual`, `composite`, `oral_witnessed`, `oral_customary`, `holographic`, `notarised`, `privileged_will` or `string` | | The type of will. Extension types use x-inherit- prefix |
| `companionEstateId` | `string` (uuid) | | Links to a companion estate record — either a parallel estate under a different legal system, or a household companion's estate |
| `mirrorWillId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the companion estate's id when this will was created as a mirror of the companion's will. Mirror wills have substantially the same provisions — typically leaving everything to each other and then to shared beneficiaries. This field records the intent, not a guarantee that the wills remain identical (either partner may subsequently diverge) |
| `companionLinkStatus` | one of `invited`, `active`, `decoupling`, `decoupled` | | Current state of the companion estate link. Absent if the estate has never been linked to a companion |
| `linkedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | ISO 8601 timestamp when the companion link became active |
| `decoupledAt` | `string` (date-time) | | ISO 8601 timestamp when the companion link was severed |
| `primaryInstrument` | one of `will`, `revocable_trust`, `both`, `intestacy` | | The primary instrument governing succession for this estate |
| `defaultPropertyRegime` | one of `community_property`, `separate_property`, `equitable_distribution`, `deferred_community`, `universal_community`, `participation_in_acquisitions`, `islamic_dower` | | The default marital property regime for this estate. Determines which assets the testator may freely dispose of |
| `totalEstimatedValue` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Estimated total value of the estate before liabilities. In minor currency units |
| `netEstateEquity` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Total value of the estate after netting secured charges against the assets they charge and subtracting unsecured liabilities, in minor currency units. The after-liabilities counterpart to totalEstimatedValue. A convenience denormalisation: the authoritative figure is derived, not stored |
| `attestation` | [Attestation](attestation.md) | | Will execution formalities — witnesses, signing method, and compliance checks |
| `testamentaryCapacity` | [TestamentaryCapacity](#def-TestamentaryCapacity) | | Record of testamentary capacity assessment for the testator |
| `codicils` | array of [Codicil](#def-Codicil) | | Amendments to the will. Each codicil must be executed with proper formalities |
| `revokesDocumentIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Document IDs of prior wills or instruments this estate record expressly revokes |
| `revocationClause` | `boolean` | | Whether the will contains a general revocation clause ('I revoke all former wills and testamentary dispositions') |
| `forcedHeirship` | [ForcedHeirship](#def-ForcedHeirship) | | Forced heirship regime applicable to this estate, if any |
| `adjudicatingBodies` | array of [AdjudicatingBody](#def-AdjudicatingBody) | | Courts and bodies with jurisdiction over this estate. Plural legal systems may involve multiple courts |
| `parallelDistributions` | array of [ParallelDistribution](#def-ParallelDistribution) | | Parallel distribution schemes under different legal systems — customary, religious, or statutory |
| `probateGrant` | [ProbateGrant](#def-ProbateGrant) | | The probate grant or letters of administration for this estate |
| `deathRecord` | [DeathRecord](#def-DeathRecord) | | Details of the testator's death |
| `successionConflicts` | array of [SuccessionConflict](#def-SuccessionConflict) | | Known conflicts between legal systems regarding succession for this estate |
| `choiceOfLaw` | `object` | | Choice of law declaration under the Brussels IV Regulation (EU Succession Regulation 650/2012) or equivalent. Allows the testator to choose which jurisdiction's succession law applies |
| `electiveShareRight` | `object` | | Surviving spouse's elective share right (US). Allows the spouse to claim a statutory share of the estate regardless of the will's provisions |
| `priorMatrimonialClaim` | `object` | | A prior matrimonial claim against the estate — typically from a former spouse under a financial order |
| `noContestClause` | `object` | | In terrorem (no-contest) clause — a provision that a beneficiary forfeits their gift if they challenge the will. Enforceability varies by jurisdiction |
| `pretermittedHeirClaims` | array of `object` | | Claims by pretermitted heirs — children born or adopted after the will was executed who are not mentioned in it |
| `testamentaryPromises` | array of `object` | | Claims under the Law Reform (Testamentary Promises) Act 1949 (New Zealand). Allows claims by persons who provided services to the deceased in reliance on a promise of testamentary provision |
| `judicialVariationPower` | `object` | | Court power to vary a will to make reasonable financial provision for family and dependants. Applies in England and Wales (Inheritance Act 1975), New Zealand, and similar jurisdictions |
| `commorientesRule` | `object` | | Commorientes rule — the legal presumption for order of death when two or more people die in the same event. Critical for determining which estate inherits from which |
| `ancillaryProbate` | array of `object` | | Ancillary probate proceedings in jurisdictions other than the primary domiciliary jurisdiction. Required when the estate includes assets in foreign jurisdictions |
| `registrations` | array of `object` | | Registrations of the will with official will registries. Not all jurisdictions have will registries, and registration is rarely compulsory |
| `reportingCurrency` | `string` | | The currency used for probate reporting and estate accounts. All values in this estate may need converting to this currency |
| `conversionRates` | array of `object` | | Exchange rates used when converting foreign-currency assets to the reporting currency. Document the rate and date to satisfy probate courts |
| `taxTreatyPositions` | array of `object` | | Tax treaty positions relevant to the estate. Documents which treaties are being relied upon for double taxation relief |
| `suggestedPractitionerNeeds` | array of `string` | | Informational list of practitioner activity codes suggesting the types of professional help this estate may need. Computed from estate complexity, not user-entered |
| `createdAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | Timestamp when this estate record was first created |
| `lastModifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | Timestamp when this estate record was last modified |
| `executionDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the will was formally executed (signed with proper attestation). Enables look-back period calculations when combined with lifetime transfers |
| `administration` | `object` | | Estate administration details. Tracks the journey from death through grant, tax clearance, distribution, and closure |
| `defaultSuccessionRegime` | `object` | | The default succession regime for all assets and properties in this estate. Individual assets/properties may override with their own successionRegime |
| `religiousConsideration` | `object` | | The testator's faith-based wishes for succession. Explicitly separate from legal succession regime — may or may not be binding depending on jurisdiction |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about the estate. Use for anything not captured by structured fields |
| `deathCertificateDate` | `string` (date) | | Date of the death certificate |
| `deathCertificateReference` | `string` | | Death certificate reference number |
| `administrationDeadline` | `string` (date) | | Target deadline for completing estate administration |
| `administrationDeadlineSource` | `string` | | Source or basis for the administration deadline |
| `probateReadiness` | array of [ProbateReadiness](#def-ProbateReadiness) | | Machine-generated completeness assessments against jurisdiction-specific probate form requirements. This is data completeness, NOT legal validation — it says 'you haven't entered the death certificate reference yet', not 'this estate is legally ready for probate' |
| `externalReferences` | array of [ExternalReference](#def-ExternalReference) | | References to this estate in external systems — practice management software, court filing systems, government portals. Enables round-trip synchronisation between INHERIT and PMS |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `jurisdictionRules` | `object` | | Conflict of laws rules governing this estate — determines which jurisdiction's succession law applies to which assets |
| `contestability` | `object` | | Structured assessment of grounds on which this will could be contested — the challenge surface |
| `taxTreaties` | array of `object` | | Double taxation treaties affecting this estate — determines which jurisdiction taxes which assets and how double taxation is relieved |
| `deathVerification` | `object` | | Verification of the testator's death — addresses the delegation trigger gap identified by the OpenID Foundation |
| `escheatment` | `object` | | Escheatment — the reversion of unclaimed estate property to the state. Applies when no valid heirs can be identified after statutory dormancy periods |
| `testamentaryScenarios` | array of `object` | | Testamentary scenarios — declarative conditions for mirror wills, survivorship, commorientes, and remarriage revocation |
| `integrity` | `object` | | Cryptographic digest of the canonical form of this document, excluding the integrity field itself — used for tamper detection and signing readiness |
| `disinheritedPersons` | array of `object` | | Persons whom the testator has explicitly excluded from inheriting. Distinguishes deliberate exclusion from oversight — critical for family provision and forced heirship claims |
| `governingJurisdictions` | array of `object` | | Jurisdictions governing succession for this estate, with scope. Use when multiple legal systems apply to different assets (e.g. lex situs for immovable property abroad). Per-asset law is recorded on each asset/property via applicableLaw; this array provides the estate-level coordination map |
| `mutualWillAgreement` | `object` | | A binding mutual will agreement — two testators promise not to revoke their wills without notice. Creates a constructive trust on the survivor's estate. Distinct from mirror wills (which are independent) |
| `parallelSuccessionConflicts` | array of `object` | | Conflicts between parallel legal systems where the will cannot override customary or statutory rights |
| `careProvisions` | array of `object` | | Ongoing care provisions for dependent adults, linking person, trust, and guardian |
| `familyProvisionClaims` | array of `object` | | Potential or actual family provision claims against the estate. Tracks claims under statutes like the Inheritance (Provision for Family and Dependants) Act 1975 |
| `connections` | array of `object` | | Non-familial connections between people in the estate. Directed: fromPersonId has the connection to toPersonId |
| `constructionClauses` | array of `object` | | Interpretive and construction rules expressed in the will |
| `validityStatus` | array of `object` | | Ongoing validity state of the will. Records life events that may invalidate the document |
| `administrationPhases` | array of `object` | | Universal priority phases for estate administration. Lower priority numbers satisfied first |
| `executorPowers` | array of `object` | | Statutory and express powers granted to executors/trustees for estate administration |
| `statutoryExclusions` | array of `object` | | Statutes explicitly excluded from applying to this estate. Common: Apportionment Act 1870, Trustee Act 2000 s.31/s.32 |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-AdjudicatingBody"></a>

### AdjudicatingBody

A court or authority with jurisdiction over this estate or part of it. Plural legal systems may have multiple adjudicating bodies for the same estate

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | one of `secular_court`, `religious_court`, `beth_din`, `shariah_court`, `tribal_court`, `family_court`, `family_council`, `community_elders`, `partition_meeting`, `karta_decision`, `maori_land_court`, `high_court` | yes | The type of adjudicating body |
| `name` | `string` | | Name of the specific court or body |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction this adjudicating body operates in |
| `caseReference` | `string` | | Case or filing reference number |
| `authoritative` | `boolean` | | Whether this body's decisions are binding. A beth din ruling may be persuasive but not enforceable without secular court recognition |

<a id="def-Codicil"></a>

### Codicil

An amendment to an existing will. Codicils must be executed with the same formalities as the will itself

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this codicil |
| `codicilDate` | `string` (date) | yes | Date the codicil was executed |
| `description` | `string` | | Summary of what this codicil changes in the original will |
| `attestation` | [Attestation](attestation.md) | | Execution formalities for this codicil |
| `documentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Document entity storing the codicil text |
| `amendsClauseIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Clause identifiers in the original will that this codicil amends. Enables computing the effective will after amendments |
| `revokesClauseIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Clause identifiers in the original will that this codicil revokes entirely |
| `priorDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Identifier of the will or codicil that this codicil amends — links to the Document entity of the prior instrument |
| `effectiveDate` | `string` (date) | | Date when this codicil takes effect, if different from the execution date — supports conditional or deferred codicils |

<a id="def-DeathRecord"></a>

### DeathRecord

Details of the testator's death. Establishes the date from which succession takes effect and the domicile at death (which determines governing law for moveables)

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dateOfDeath` | `string` (date) | | Date of death in ISO 8601 format |
| `placeOfDeath` | `string` | | Place where death occurred |
| `deathCertificateRef` | `string` | | Death certificate reference number |
| `domicileAtDeath` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The testator's domicile at the time of death. This determines which succession law governs moveable property |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about the death record |

<a id="def-ExternalReference"></a>

### ExternalReference

A reference to this estate in an external system — practice management software, court filing systems, government portals

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system` | `string` | yes | The external system name |
| `referenceId` | `string` | yes | The matter/case/action ID in the external system |
| `referenceType` | one of `matter`, `contact`, `document`, `case`, `action`, `filing`, `other` or `string` | yes | What type of entity this references in the external system |
| `referenceUrl` | `string` (uri) | | Deep link to the entity in the external system |
| `syncedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this reference was last synchronised |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context about this reference |

<a id="def-ForcedHeirship"></a>

### ForcedHeirship

Forced heirship regime details. Many civil law jurisdictions reserve a portion of the estate for certain heirs regardless of the will

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `applies` | `boolean` | | Whether forced heirship rules apply to this estate |
| `reservedPortion` | `number` | | Percentage of the estate reserved for protected heirs. In France, this is 50% for one child, 66.67% for two, 75% for three or more |
| `disposableQuota` | `number` | | Percentage of the estate the testator may freely dispose of by will |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction whose forced heirship rules apply |
| `claimNature` | one of `property_share`, `cash_claim`, `usufruct`, `court_discretion` | | The legal nature of the forced heir's claim — whether they receive property, cash, or a court-determined provision |
| `calculationBasis` | one of `fixed`, `per_child_sliding`, `court_discretion`, `conditional` | | How the reserved portion is calculated |
| `applicableTo` | one of `children_only`, `children_and_spouse`, `all_descendants`, `all_heirs` | | Which categories of heir are protected by forced heirship |
| `deferralRule` | `string` | | Rule for deferring forced heirship claims — e.g. life interest to surviving spouse with remainder to children |
| `effectiveDate` | `string` (date) | | Date when the applicable forced heirship rules came into force. Important for reform transitions |
| `reformVersion` | `string` | | The specific legislative reform establishing these rules |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes on forced heirship — exceptions, pending challenges, or reform context |

<a id="def-ParallelDistribution"></a>

### ParallelDistribution

A parallel distribution scheme operating alongside the primary estate distribution. Common in plural legal systems where statutory and customary/religious distributions run concurrently

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system` | `string` | yes | The legal system governing this parallel distribution |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction where this parallel distribution applies |
| `description` | `string` | | Summary of how this system distributes the estate |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context or conflict notes |

<a id="def-ProbateGrant"></a>

### ProbateGrant

A grant of probate or letters of administration issued by a court. Without a grant, executors have no legal authority to administer the estate

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `grantType` | `string` | | The type of grant issued |
| `grantDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the grant was issued by the court |
| `grantReference` | `string` | | Court reference number for the grant |
| `issuingCourt` | `string` | | Name of the court or registry that issued the grant |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction that issued this grant |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about the grant |

<a id="def-ProbateReadiness"></a>

### ProbateReadiness

Completeness assessment of estate data against a jurisdiction-specific probate form. This is data completeness, NOT legal validation

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | yes | The jurisdiction this assessment applies to |
| `targetForm` | `string` | yes | Form identifier from form-requirements.json |
| `requiredFieldsPresent` | `integer` | yes | Number of required fields that are populated |
| `requiredFieldsTotal` | `integer` | yes | Total number of required fields for this form |
| `missingFields` | array of `string` | | INHERIT field paths that are required by the form but not yet populated |
| `assessedAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | When this assessment was performed |
| `assessedBy` | one of `system`, `solicitor`, `willscan`, `manual` or `string` | | Who or what performed the assessment |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context about the assessment |

<a id="def-SuccessionConflict"></a>

### SuccessionConflict

A conflict between legal systems regarding succession for this estate. Common in plural jurisdictions and cross-border estates

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `string` | yes | Summary of the conflict between legal systems |
| `systems` | array of `string` | | The legal systems in conflict |
| `resolutionStatus` | one of `unresolved`, `resolved`, `pending_court`, `pending_arbitration` | | Current status of this conflict |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context or resolution details |

<a id="def-TestamentaryCapacity"></a>

### TestamentaryCapacity

Record of testamentary capacity assessment. The testator must understand the nature of making a will, the extent of their estate, and the claims of those they are excluding

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assessed` | `boolean` | | Whether a capacity assessment was carried out |
| `assessmentDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the capacity assessment took place |
| `assessorName` | `string` | | Name of the person who assessed capacity |
| `assessorRole` | `string` | | Professional role of the assessor — typically a GP, psychiatrist, or solicitor |
| `capacityConfirmed` | `boolean` | | Whether the assessor confirmed the testator has testamentary capacity |
| `goldenRuleComplied` | `boolean` | | Whether the 'golden rule' was followed — a medical practitioner assessing capacity for elderly or seriously ill testators |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes on the capacity assessment |
